description:
Land Acquisition - Meepitiya, Pasbagekorale D/S/D, Kandy District 
                           - Pallegama, Pasbagekorale D/S/D, Kandy District
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of specific plots of land for a public purpose. It provides detailed legal descriptions, boundaries, and extents of the land parcels. While a government minister's name and title are present, the core subject matter is exclusively land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification. The government personnel detail is incidental to the execution of the land-related legal procedure.
